definitions.explanation: A person employed in government service. Often carries a slightly negative connotation of bureaucratic rigidity or indifference, unlike the more neutral 公務員.

examples.japanese: {役人|やくにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}た→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧。
examples.english: I submitted a report to the official.

examples.japanese: {役人|やくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧。
examples.english: Bureaucrats are always slow to respond.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役人|やくにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まり→取り締まり：07445_torishimari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Officials in the Edo period carried out strict enforcement.

notes:
{役人|やくにん} refers to a government official or bureaucrat. The word often implies a stereotypical bureaucratic attitude — rigid, procedural, and sometimes unhelpful.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公務員|こうむいん}→公務員：01588_koumuin⟧: civil servant (neutral, modern term for government employees)
- ⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧: bureaucrat, high-ranking official (more formal, focuses on the system)
- {役人|やくにん}: government official (slightly negative, implies bureaucratic behavior)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{役人|やくにん}: government official (with polite prefix, sometimes ironic)
- {役人|やくにん}⟦{根性|こんじょう}→根性：19215_konjou⟧: bureaucratic mentality
- {役人|やくにん}⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: bureaucratic work (implies going through the motions)
